entities.name: Endoribonuclease YbeY
observations: The supplied 154-aa sequence exactly matches reviewed Anaplasma marginale YbeY references (100% identity and coverage; E-value 4.39e-110).
Annotated as a single-strand-specific metallo-endoribonuclease involved in late-stage 70S ribosome quality control and maturation of the 16S rRNA 3′ terminus.
Reference annotation reports one Zn2+ cofactor and cytoplasmic localization.
Sequence-derived estimates: molecular mass 17,605.341 Da; pI 6.156; instability index 40.022; GRAVY −0.0117.

observations: Zinc(II) ion is annotated as a cofactor bound by YbeY reference proteins.
